parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the event stream.

parameters.name: EventStreamingName
parameters.description: The name of the event stream.

parameters.name: FilterPattern
parameters.description: The event filtering rule. If you do not specify this parameter, all events are matched. For more information, see [https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/eventbridge/user-guide/event-patterns](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/eventbridge/user-guide/event-patterns)

parameters.name: Metadata
parameters.description: The generic JSON configurations for the event provider. This parameter is mutually exclusive with Source.

parameters.name: Sink
parameters.description: The event target. You must select exactly one Sink type.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The event provider. You must select one and only one type of Source.

sub_parameters.name: Arn
sub_parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the cloud service, such as the ARN of a function in Function Compute.
